basis: Immune-mediated granulomatous skin disease; no common direct extracutaneous damage.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: granuloma annulare is mediated by a cutaneous cellular immune response; an unknown initiating cause does not exclude immune mediation.

basis: Intestinal atresia and combined immunodeficiency define the syndrome; persistent sparse hair and absent eyebrows occur in 30-79%.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent hypotrichosis and absent eyebrows are structural hair deficits reported in 30-79%; hair is within the dermatologic axis.

basis: Severe intellectual disability and skeletal contractures define the syndrome; hypospadias 80-99%, oral/intestinal defects 30-79%. Strabismus and nail abnormalities omitted at the cap.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias affects the urethra, explicitly within renal, and occurs in 80-99%; it is not solely a reproductive-organ anomaly.
decisions.ocular: none: strabismus occurs in 30-79% but is omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of more frequent or consequential abnormalities.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: joint contractures, restricted mobility and skeletal developmental defects are defining features, with multiple findings in 80-99%.

basis: Immune-mediated axial arthritis; anterior uveitis is a direct extra-articular inflammatory manifestation affecting approximately 30-40% over the disease course.

decisions.ocular: involved: anterior uveitis affects approximately 30-40% over the course and is a recognized inflammatory manifestation of the disease.

basis: Glycogen metabolism disorder with defining severe prenatal myopathy; respiratory failure does not establish lung damage, and pulmonary hypoplasia lacks an established >=30% frequency.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure can result from severe myopathy; intrinsic pulmonary hypoplasia is not established as affecting >=30% or as a major diagnostic criterion.

basis: Spastic paraplegia, peripheral neuropathy and optic atrophy define the syndrome; muscle wasting in 2/2 reflects denervation rather than a primary muscle process.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle wasting in 2/2 is neurogenic; the nonspecific Achilles tendon finding does not establish direct musculoskeletal damage.

basis: Lysosomal neurodegeneration with bladder loss of function in 2/3; respiratory insufficiency in 3/3 does not establish intrinsic lung injury, and cortical visual loss is neurologic.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory insufficiency in 3/3 establishes impaired ventilation but does not demonstrate direct lung or airway damage from the disease.

basis: Long-QT arrhythmia and syndactyly define TS1; neurodevelopmental impairment occurs in approximately 65%, and structural dental defects in approximately 35%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: structural dental abnormalities, including enamel or tooth developmental defects, are reported in approximately 35%; teeth belong to gastrointestinal.

basis: Soil-induced lymphatic obstruction causes defining chronic skin and subcutaneous changes with elephantiasis; lymphatic vessels are not explicitly included in cardiovascular.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the affected vessels are lymphatics, outside the stated cardiovascular coverage; blood-vessel disease is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: chronic cutaneous and subcutaneous swelling, thickening and fibrosis constitute the defining elephantiasis phenotype.

basis: Thymic gland carcinoma with endocrine-neoplasm ancestry; vena cava involvement and phrenic dysfunction causing diaphragmatic paralysis are each reported in 30-79%.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: vena cava abnormality with obstructive manifestations supports direct vessel compromise; supplied HPO frequency is 30-79%.
decisions.neurologic: involved: diaphragmatic paralysis supports loss of phrenic nerve function from local tumor involvement; supplied HPO frequency is 30-79%.
